noticias.titulo: How AI is reshaping the foundation of front-office investment workflows | Insights | Bloomberg Professional Services
noticias.resumo: Rather than manually searching through research reports, earnings transcripts, company filings, market commentary, portfolio reports and internal content, investors can use natural-language queries to interrogate a topic and surface relevant research and portfolio context within the workflow.  This makes information easier to connect, share and analyze, strengthening the collaboration between analysts, portfolio managers and traders.  Teams can challenge assumptions, refine investment theses and build conviction together on one integrated workflow.
